task_title: Fix performance bug in database query optimization code
summary: Successfully identified and fixed 3 performance bugs in the database query optimizer

fixes_implemented.description: Cache key was generated using O(n log n) sort operation for every call
fixes_implemented.fix: Implemented hash-based cache key using sum/min/max for O(n) complexity

fixes_implemented.description: LRU eviction iterated through all entries to find oldest (O(n))
fixes_implemented.fix: Added access order tracking array for O(1) eviction

fixes_implemented.issue: No batch chunking for large inserts
fixes_implemented.description: Large batch inserts could exceed query size limits

additional_improvements: Updated getCached to maintain true LRU ordering on access
Updated clearCache to also clear access order tracking
